name: Technical Assessment Taking & Diagnostics Flow
description: Verifies role selection, starting dynamic technical assessment, answering questions, running sandbox test cases, and viewing diagnostic skill breakdown.

planSteps.description: Click 'Assessments & Practice' in the navigation sidebar
Assert that the 8 target role cards and experience level selector buttons are visible
Click 'Start Assessment' to launch a personalized test session
Assert that the Active Assessment Arena is displayed with question progress and number palette
Select an answer option for the active question and click 'Next Question'
Assert that the Diagnostic Report appears with overall score percentage, skill competency bars, and question review explanations
